resources.string: Sends this TV\'s system audio to your phone over Wi-Fi. No cloud, no accounts.
No receivers found yet. Start the receiver app on the phone, then scan. If mDNS is blocked on your router, type the phone\'s IP address instead.
Latency test: click once per second
Enter the receiver IP address or scan for receivers
Microphone permission is required to capture TV audio
No audio captured for 10 s. DRM-protected apps (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video) block audio capture and will stay silent. Try YouTube or another app, and make sure the TV volume is not muted.
Latency test: a click plays on the TV and in the hearing aids once per second. The gap is the real end-to-end latency.
Shows that TV audio is being streamed to the phone
Invalid receiver address \"%1$s\". Enter an IP like 192.168.1.42
MediaProjection could not be created. The TV box may not support audio capture.
Android refused the audio-capture service. Allow the capture permission once over adb: %1$s
The system did not allow the streaming service to start. Bring this app to the front (screen on) and press Start again.
Screen-capture permission data is missing. Try starting again.
Audio capture could not start (see logcat tag AudioBridgeCapture)
Capture was stopped by the system

If the TV box never shows the capture permission dialog, allow it once over adb:

adb shell appops set %1$s PROJECT_MEDIA allow

DRM apps (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video) block audio capture and will stream silence. YouTube and most other apps work.

Connect with USB or adb over Wi-Fi and run:

adb shell appops set %1$s PROJECT_MEDIA allow

Then press “Try again”.
This TV box does not provide the screen-capture permission screen that MediaProjection needs. The usual fix is to allow the PROJECT_MEDIA app-op over adb.
The TV box did not grant audio capture. Some boxes need the PROJECT_MEDIA app-op allowed over adb before the dialog works.
